_doc: Camera credential resolution. Maps camera model (from lodge.db) to .env variable prefix.
_how: Lookup: model -> prefix -> .env ${prefix}_USER / ${prefix}_PASS. Per-IP override: CAM_{last_octet}_USER / CAM_{last_octet}_PASS. Default: admin / empty.
_consumers: camera-service/api/server.py, fasttag/server.py, nvr-service/server.py — all use get_camera_credentials(model, ip)
_note: Credentials are NOT stored in lodge.db. They live here + .env only, so the git-tracked snapshot stays clean.
